digest.component_or_area: test suite: snapshot fetch stall abort and ACLI subprocess timeout
propositions: test_slow_but_progressing_remote_is_not_aborted uses a 15-second real loopback server with a 10-second low-speed window, causing multi-second wall time per matrix cell
test_read_retried_then_terminal consumes ~9 seconds due to one-second call timeout plus production backoff sleeps across three real child processes
injected one-second low-speed window into slow-progress test retains real loopback socket and above-floor byte pacing for more than one complete window without stall classification
ACLI subprocess test installs sub-second call/grace/drain values and records exact 2s/4s logical retry schedule without real sleeps while launching exactly _MAX_ATTEMPTS real process sessions
every PID launched by ACLI read sentinel must be absent after terminal failure, verified via polling with generous cleanup deadline
production timeout, stall, grace, drain, attempt, and backoff defaults remain unchanged
